title: CI step 'Structure budgets + dependency rules' (pnpm lint:structure) fails on ubuntu: loc 12 files over budget, dirsize 5 dirs over budget, root has 18 loose files (budget 15)
evidence: node scripts/lint-loc.mjs --all on lane/cifix 514be40d: loc violations e.g. packages/index/src/pipeline/speakers-grounded.ts:371 (300), packages/meeting-bot/py/sb_join.py:1191 (300), apps/api/src/ask/source-context.ts:308; dirsize e.g. packages/index/src/pipeline 33 files (30), scripts/lib 39 (30); root: git ls-files shows exactly 18 root files (budget 15). Filesystem-independent (tracked content), so same on CI. CI never reached this step yet because 'Unit tests' fails first.
fix_direction: Split/raise budgets via the Approver path (structure.config.json is Approver-owned) or reduce files; not a test-only fix

title: lint-dupes fails (7 duplicate exported names) and dependency-cruiser reports no-circular packages/ask/src/ask-graph.ts <-> ask-v2.ts; both in the same CI step
evidence: lint-dupes: Assessment, Verdict, evaluate, FFMPEG_ENV (core/keyframes/ffmpeg-args.ts vs ingest/sources/youtube.ts), GraphNode, Row, Candidate. dependency-cruiser: error no-circular ask-graph.ts -> ask-v2.ts -> ask-graph.ts (real source cycle). Also 'no-unresolvable-workspace-import apps/api/scripts/build.mjs -> esbuild' seen locally but esbuild is in apps/api/package.json and the lockfile, so that one is Windows/worktree-only.
fix_direction: Break the ask-graph/ask-v2 cycle; rename or de-duplicate the 7 exports or add reasoned allowlist entries

title: @lkb/meeting-bot tests depend on cwd = repo root, but CI (pnpm -r test) runs them with cwd = packages/meeting-bot; 2 tests fail on ubuntu
evidence: From packages/meeting-bot: 'actual login/tab/OBS spawn interfaces preserve parent and carry identical selector' fails ENOENT copyfile '...\packages\meeting-bot\packages\meeting-bot\py	ab-capture\manifest.json' (tab-browser.ts:203 resolves a repo-relative path against cwd); same file run from repo root passes. 'registration actual child timeout performs exact owned-profile cleanup' fails ENOENT mkdtemp packages/meeting-bot/data/registration-timeout-XXXXXX (untracked data/ dir; also hardcodes .venv/Scripts/python.exe, absent on ubuntu). Not yet observed on CI because pnpm -r bails at the core failure first.
fix_direction: Resolve paths from import.meta.dirname/repo root, mkdir the temp parent, and pick the python via an env var or skip when absent
